macros.doc: A degree symbol can be obtained using \degrees or the shorter form \0; for example 120\0 gives 120◦ .

macros.name: degrees
macros.doc: A degree symbol can be obtained using \degrees or the shorter form \0; for example 120\0 gives 120◦ .

macros.name: fr
macros.doc: Within the recipe you can use \fr to typeset fractions using \fr12 to get 1/2, or \fr{11}{12} to typeset 11/12.

macros.name: freeform
macros.doc: To typeset text across the whole width of the recipe instead of just the width of the method, use the \freeform command.

macros.name: newstep
macros.doc: Within the recipe environment, to force a new step if you do not want to declare any ingredients, use the \newstep command.

macros.name: recipefont
macros.doc: \recipefont is the default font for the other recipe fonts; thus the other fonts inherit from this but can be altered individually.

arg.snippet: RecipeWidths{${1:total width}}{${2:servings width}}{${3:step number width}}{${4:ingredient width}}{${5:quantity width}}{${6:units width}}

macros.name: ResetRecipeCounter
macros.doc: The \ResetRecipeCounter command will reset the recipe counter so that subsequent recipes are numbered from 1.

macros.name: X
macros.doc: A times symbol, × , can be obtained using \X.
